review_scope: Read-only source/algorithm-spec integration audit; no test, planner, simulator or proof recomputation during formal CPU experiments.

checks.finding: All three preregistered main seeds call Planner.plan(...,continuous=True). There is no formal experiment flag disabling B1.
Lift and placement are checked local connections. Transport is reconstructed solely from accepted parent edges of the search tree, retaining their dense projected midpoints.
Full-candidate validation requires exact numeric equality of object matrices and all fourteen joints at lift/transport and transport/place boundaries; no unplanned tolerance bridge is inserted.

All six complete geometry trajectories, including dense NR/RBS nodes, use the original checker.validate defaults. Every reason and every non-sampled-edge-valid result is rejection evidence. Planner cannot accept when confirm_plan.valid is false.

The independent R1 inputs consist of detached3, attach3, begin-lift1, lift-end3, transport-boundaries2, begin-place1, target-support3, release3: nineteen in total, independent of dense path size. Fixed 20ms synthetic timestamps and new provenance are independent from geometric path timestamps; dense/interpolated nodes are never sent to R1. Any R1 rejection or unconfirmed final release makes candidate validation false.

Complete geometric trajectories use default enforce_temporal_confirmation=False and no temporal prelude/terminal phase. Original B1 verifies those same geometry trajectories; the separate temporal_session result is retained, not falsely attributed to B1 internals.

CandidateValidator invokes unchanged ContinuousVerifier(checker,max_depth=0). Its joint_limits,closed_chain,collision,combined outputs are stored without promoting any inconclusive dimension. Full proof details remain in result archives and per-dimension statuses in summaries.
After sampled and R1 success, any original B1 combined_status CONTINUOUSLY_REJECTED causes explicit rejection and continued search. B1 combines any rejected dimension into rejected combined_status.

Runtime implementation imports accepted mathematical/model gates but contains no reads of old A-stage paths, r1_configurations, test control states, or precomputed IK solutions. Anchor seeds are HOME, joint midpoint, or deterministic RNG; all trajectory joint states arise from current NR calls. Tests-only control fixtures are outside runtime.

Accepted sampled candidates retain OFFLINE_CANDIDATE_UNCERTIFIED and execution_authorized=False. Static review does not establish planning success, continuous safety, dynamics, measured timing, or physical execution.

limitations: This is a static integration review, not evidence that any formal seed found a candidate.
Real B0/R1/B1 outcomes and exact residuals must be read from the preregistered run archives.
Unresolved original continuous proofs remain unresolved and prohibit an execution authorization.
